description: Review-only Azure modernization task plan for PhotoAlbum.

tasks.description: Capture current PhotoAlbum behavior and establish the frozen verification baseline.
tasks.reason: A baseline allows migrated photo, database, and configuration behavior to be checked against the existing application.
tasks.requirements: Snapshot the main application source at PhotoAlbum and document current photo upload, retrieval, deletion, and metadata behavior for later verification. Addresses assessment issues: none directly (baseline only).

tasks.description: Move photo-file storage from the local filesystem to Azure Blob Storage.
tasks.reason: Local files are not durable or shared across scaled application instances.
tasks.requirements: Preserve the existing photo service behavior while storing and retrieving image objects from a private Blob container using managed identity. Keep database metadata and file operations consistent, and verify upload, retrieval, and deletion. Affected files: PhotoAlbum/Services/IPhotoService.cs, PhotoAlbum/Services/PhotoService.cs, PhotoAlbum/Pages/PhotoFile.cshtml.cs, PhotoAlbum/Program.cs, PhotoAlbum/PhotoAlbum.csproj. Addresses assessment issues: Local or network IO operations detected.

tasks.description: Move photo metadata persistence from LocalDB to Azure SQL Database.
tasks.reason: LocalDB is unsuitable for a managed cloud application and the current connection string is machine-specific.
tasks.requirements: Retain the EF Core data model and queries while connecting to Azure SQL with Microsoft Entra ID/managed identity. Define a controlled production schema migration process rather than requiring concurrent application instances to migrate the database on startup. Affected files: PhotoAlbum/Data/PhotoAlbumContext.cs, PhotoAlbum/Program.cs, PhotoAlbum/appsettings.json, PhotoAlbum/Migrations/. Addresses assessment issues: SQL database connection detected; Connection string is detected.

tasks.description: Externalize cloud application settings and protect required secrets.
tasks.reason: Local configuration and legacy connection-string files should not define production service endpoints or credentials.
tasks.requirements: Move non-secret settings to Azure App Configuration and any required sensitive values to Key Vault, accessed with managed identity. Retain the current fail-closed admin login behavior. Remove the stale Web.config LocalDB entry only after confirming it is not needed by the supported hosting path. Affected files: PhotoAlbum/Program.cs, PhotoAlbum/appsettings.json, PhotoAlbum/appsettings.Development.json, PhotoAlbum/Web.config, PhotoAlbum/Pages/Login.cshtml.cs. Addresses assessment issues: Local application configuration detected; Connection string is detected; Connection strings without configuration builders detected.

tasks.description: Instrument application telemetry for Azure Monitor.
tasks.reason: Managed cloud hosting needs consistent operational logs, metrics, and traces.
tasks.requirements: Add OpenTelemetry-based application instrumentation and configure export to Azure Monitor without logging credentials or sensitive photo metadata. Affected files: PhotoAlbum/Program.cs, PhotoAlbum/PhotoAlbum.csproj. Addresses assessment issues: none directly (proactive observability modernization).

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate verified security risks.
tasks.reason: Known vulnerable dependencies and avoidable cloud resource exposure must be addressed before production rollout.
tasks.requirements: Scan all PhotoAlbum and test project dependencies for CVEs and upgrade to patched versions, documenting major-version risks. Review the existing infrastructure configuration for secret-safe SQL bootstrap credentials, least-privilege identity roles, disabled ACR admin access when unnecessary, private Blob access, and restricted network exposure. Addresses assessment issues: none directly; the reported hardcoded sensitive data and Windows authentication findings were not confirmed in current files.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for migrated Azure services and run post-migration verification
tasks.reason: Verify that the migrated service integrations preserve the baseline behavior.
tasks.requirements: Use mocked external dependencies for post-migration verification; cover photo upload, retrieval, deletion, SQL-backed metadata, and application configuration. Addresses assessment issues: none directly (verification task for the confirmed local IO, configuration, and SQL findings).
